list.name: mentor
list.label: Ментор
list.query: SELECT mt.telegram_id AS __value, COALESCE(u.name, u.username) AS __text FROM iam.mentors mt JOIN iam.users u ON u.telegram_id = mt.telegram_id ORDER BY __text

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Учеников"
FROM iam.mentees me
JOIN iam.mentors mt ON mt.id = me.mentor_id
WHERE mt.telegram_id = $mentor

SELECT COUNT(*) AS "Созвонов"
FROM meetings.meetings m
WHERE m.mentor_telegram_id = $mentor
  AND m.scheduled_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

SELECT ROUND(AVG(a.value_int)::numeric, 2) AS "Средняя оценка"
FROM surveys.survey_sessions ss
JOIN surveys.survey_answers a ON a.session_id = ss.id
JOIN meetings.meetings m ON m.id = ss.context_id::int
WHERE a.value_int IS NOT NULL
  AND ss.status = 'completed'
  AND ss.context_type = 'meeting'
  AND m.mentor_telegram_id = $mentor
  AND m.scheduled_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ss.id) AS "Опросов"
FROM surveys.survey_sessions ss
JOIN meetings.meetings m ON m.id = ss.context_id::int
WHERE ss.status = 'completed'
  AND ss.context_type = 'meeting'
  AND m.mentor_telegram_id = $mentor
  AND m.scheduled_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

SELECT
  date_trunc('week', m.scheduled_at) AS time,
  COUNT(*) AS "Созвонов"
FROM meetings.meetings m
WHERE m.mentor_telegram_id = $mentor
  AND m.scheduled_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  me.doc_name AS "Ученик",
  COALESCE(c.value, 'Без стадии') AS "Стадия",
  me.student_score AS "Балл",
  CASE WHEN me.contract THEN 'Да' ELSE 'Нет' END AS "Контракт",
  COUNT(DISTINCT mtg.id) AS "Созвонов"
FROM iam.mentees me
JOIN iam.mentors mt ON mt.id = me.mentor_id
LEFT JOIN integrations.user_cohorts uc ON uc.user_telegram_id = me.telegram_id
LEFT JOIN integrations.cohorts c ON c.id = uc.cohort_id AND c.type = 'Status'
LEFT JOIN meetings.meeting_users mu ON mu.user_id = me.telegram_id
LEFT JOIN meetings.meetings mtg ON mtg.id = mu.meeting_id
  AND mtg.scheduled_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
WHERE mt.telegram_id = $mentor
GROUP BY me.doc_name, c.value, me.student_score, me.contract
ORDER BY me.doc_name

SELECT
  q.title AS "Вопрос",
  ROUND(AVG(a.value_int)::numeric, 2) AS "Средняя оценка"
FROM surveys.survey_answers a
JOIN surveys.survey_questions q ON q.id = a.question_id
JOIN surveys.survey_sessions ss ON ss.id = a.session_id
JOIN meetings.meetings m ON m.id = ss.context_id::int
WHERE a.value_int IS NOT NULL
  AND ss.status = 'completed'
  AND ss.context_type = 'meeting'
  AND m.mentor_telegram_id = $mentor
  AND m.scheduled_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY q.title
ORDER BY "Средняя оценка" DESC

SELECT
  date_trunc('week', a.created_at) AS time,
  ROUND(AVG(a.value_int)::numeric, 2) AS "Средняя оценка"
FROM surveys.survey_answers a
JOIN surveys.survey_sessions ss ON ss.id = a.session_id
JOIN meetings.meetings m ON m.id = ss.context_id::int
WHERE a.value_int IS NOT NULL
  AND ss.status = 'completed'
  AND ss.context_type = 'meeting'
  AND m.mentor_telegram_id = $mentor
  AND a.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
